draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.86, the 194th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 23rd of 37 at CB. He went 142nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (194th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (83rd percentile).

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys. 61 career games and 39 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (7 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 7 (93rd percentile), interceptions 3 (92nd percentile), completion % allowed 55.4% (80th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 73.0% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, above the norm.
